text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a staggered v2 rollout tonight 22:00 PT. Canary at 2% for 15m, then 10% for 20m, then full if green. Rollback triggers: >1% 5xx or P95 latency >1s sustained for 5m. I’ll kick off the deploybot job once docs are updated.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: model=v2 api=split-route start=2025-06-12T22:00:00-07:00 canary=2% then 10% -> deploy-id=db-1754321001. Use `/deploy cancel db-1754321001` to abort.

maria: Quick question — how are we signaling clients? x-api-version header only? mobile SDKs still sending v1 via header missing sometimes.
alex: Good call. We’ll honor `x-api-version` first, then fallback to `version_signal` query param. If absent, route to v1. Add a gentle 30s retry with header injection on client side. Example header check snippet:
```
if (req.headers['x-api-version'] === '2') { route('v2') } else if (req.query.version_signal === '2') { route('v2') } else { route('v1') }
```

oliver: Rollback playbook note: if 5xx >1% for 5m, do immediate soft-traffic-cut to 0% canary and notify oncall. If latency regresses, revert traffic to v1 for affected region and open incident.
release-ops: Need release notes update and migration blurb for SDKs. Who owns the doc? We should include header examples and troubleshooting tips.
alex: I’ll update release-notes.md now and ping docs for an addendum. Will include migration steps and sample curl commands.
release-ops: Also add a note about metrics keys: `api.v2.p95_latency` and `api.v2.5xx_rate` so SRE dashboards pick them up.
maria: For mobile, suggest we add a temporary server-side shim that maps missing header to v1 explicitly for 48h, so we don't accidentally route older apps to v2. Can ops create the shim toggle?
oncall: I can put a toggle in the edge router for 48h. Command to flip: `edgectl toggle header-shim --id db-1754321001 --ttl 48h`.

alex: Plan: 1) docs + release notes done 2) deploybot scheduled (done) 3) edge shim enabled TTL=48h 4) canary 2% 15m -> monitor 5) step to 10% 20m -> monitor 6) full. Abort on triggers.
maria: Adding a short checklist for SDK owners: update header, bump timeout to 10s, enable retry header injection.
deploy-bot: Reminder: set alerting window: `alerts set db-1754321001 --metric api.v2.5xx_rate --threshold 1% --window 5m` and `alerts set db-1754321001 --metric api.v2.p95_latency --threshold 1000ms --window 5m`.
release-ops: Tagging @docs and @sdk-team in release notes PR required. Also include rollback commands in PR: `edgectl toggle route v2 --percent 0` and `/deploy revert db-1754321001`.
oliver: Who’s on-call if we need immediate rollback?
oncall: I’m primary tonight from 21:30-03:30 PT. If something breaks, ping #oncall with `!pager` and I’ll run the revert.
alex: OK launching docs PR now, will kick edge shim once PR is merged. Will run the deploybot at 22:00 PT. Please be on ops-eyes during the canary window. :eyes:
maria: I’ll watch mobile signals and post any client pin requests.
release-ops: Done — release notes PR opened: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/312. Includes migration blurb and rollback steps.
alex: Thanks. See you in the deploy channel at 21:50 for final go/no-go.
